title: For Disabled Travelers in Search of Adventure, Adrenaline-Fueled Options Are Growing
content: For disabled travelers in search of adventure, there are a growing number of adrenaline-fueled options. In Oregon, one wheelchair user went tree-climbing.

title: Crowded Airport Lounges Are Rolling Out Grab-and-Go Options
content: New premium pit stops are giving fliers a place for a quick bite and drink without having to line up for increasingly crowded traditional lounges.

title: Charleston’s Charm Hides Bloody History of Revolutionary War in South Carolina
content: Some of the fiercest battles took place in South Carolina, but its part in the fight for independence is often overlooked. Our reporter found history, myths, beauty and contradiction across the Lowcountry landscapes.

title: In Portugal, Visitors are Flocking to Lisbon’s Food and Art Scenes
content: The Portuguese capital is booming with an influx of artists, retirees and visitors drawn to an exciting, affordable culinary scene and an inclusive culture.

title: Party Like a Swede! A Guide to Celebrating Midsummer.
content: The holiday celebrates the return of light after the long, dark Nordic winter. Here’s how to take part in Sweden, or wherever you are.

title: 5 Beautiful Hawaiian Swimming Holes
content: Clear natural pools, many fed by crystalline waterfalls, give visitors to Hawaii a refreshing reason to expand their explorations beyond the beach.

title: Taking Highways and Back Roads to America’s Founding
content: For the nation’s 250th anniversary, the Travel desk asked writers to retrace the steps of revolutionary figures, both in the United States and abroad.

title: Nose Gear on Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner Collapses, Injuring Several Workers
content: The airline Lufthansa said the cause of the accident at Frankfurt Airport was under investigation. The plane can weigh 279 tons at takeoff.

title: Travelers Bound for the U.K. Hit a Roadblock: Electronic Authorization System Is Down
content: Some visitors from the U.S., Canada and most European countries can’t get an electronic travel authorization and are being turned away from planes, trains and boats.

title: Joby Demonstrated its Air Taxi in Manhattan, but You Can’t Fly in It Yet
content: Aviation start-ups and the Trump administration want to replace helicopters with electric aircraft, but the new vehicles still have to pass arduous tests before the public can use them.

title: Where the Swedes Go in Summer
content: The pastoral region of Österlen has some of Sweden’s most stunning scenery and a new creative energy.

title: Uber to Offer Shuttles for Fans Leaving World Cup Matches
content: Soccer lovers frustrated by public transportation will have another option to return to Boston, Dallas, Miami and New York from hard-to-reach stadiums.

title: How to Travel if You Have Panic Attacks
content: You don’t have to let severe anxiety keep you from exploring the world. Here’s how to manage your panic on vacation.

title: My $7,300 United Business Class Seat Was Broken, and I Got a Pittance
content: A woman splurged for a lie-flat seat, but it got jammed in the horizontal position for most of the 14-hour flight. How much should United compensate her?

title: A Wellness Cruise for the Overstimulated and Totally Stressed
content: Our writer kept an open mind as she signed up for sound baths, face yoga and meditation sessions on a wellness retreat aboard a luxury Mediterranean cruise. But was it all a bit too woo-woo?

title: To Understand the American Revolution, a Writer Went to Barbados
content: It’s where the British perfected their system of enslaved labor, George Washington visited and colonialism’s legacy can still be felt. And, as a writer found on this small island, freedom is still cause for celebration.

title: Radisson Hotel Sued by Parents Who Say 11-Year-Old Daughter Was Groped in Pool
content: A man, who was not a guest at the Miami Beach hotel, was accused of assaulting the girl in the hotel’s outdoor pool.

title: How Delta Steered Around Airline Industry Chaos
content: The carrier has become the country’s most profitable by catering to affluent travelers, but it is facing stiffer competition from United.

title: Cycling in the Dutch Countryside, With a Riverboat as a Base
content: A weeklong, self-guided Netherlands biking tour, whose base is a riverboat, offers participants plenty of opportunities to get hopelessly, and entertainingly, lost.

title: Where to See the Total Solar Eclipse on Aug. 12
content: On Aug. 12, parts of Greenland, Iceland, Spain and Portugal will experience the thrill of daytime darkness. Here’s where you can witness the cosmic spectacle.
